latin: Propositio est per se cum uel subiectum diffinit praedicatum, uel praedicatum subiectum, uel ambo diffiniuntur per idem tertium.
translation: A proposition is per se when either the subject defines the predicate, or the predicate the subject, or both are defined through the same third [term].
translator: original translation, drafted 2026-09-26 by WRITER-light-batch2, from Latin at farmer1998:14898
